model.original_source_operator: same frozen Model3 reproduction, pollen self-exclusion and fully joint three-locus Mendelian inheritance
model.exact_reference: discrete finite diploid genotype-count Markov transition with categorical offspring
model.approximate: multivariate tangent Gaussian with multinomial mean/covariance BEFORE projection, clipped to nonnegative frequencies and rounded to exact integer census; postprojection law is not exactly multinomial

rare_class_projection_test.scientific_interpretation: At very rare q=0.001, the Gaussian projection/rounding numerically never represented a genotype that has strictly positive exact chance to appear; this is a fixed-kernel sampling stress, not a natural species/genetic-history result.

interpretation: Near agreement in occupied trait means is insufficient evidence of joint diploid genotype-distribution fidelity.
The Gaussian approximation has correct pre-projection first/second moments but projection and integer rounding can introduce bias.
The K32 genotype-class gap was observed after outcome exposure, and any later K32 or K128 horizon tests are exploratory diagnostics, not fresh confirmation.
No new ecological model, no validated Ito SDE or measure-valued SPDE, and no full mutation-enabled three-locus density convergence claim.
